classification.difficultyReason: Identify the shaded area as a larger area with a curved region removed.

content.prompt: Find the areas of the shaded regions. You will need to find two areas and subtract.

answer.worked:
The arch meets the $x$-axis at $x=2$ and $x=4$.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=3(6)-\int_2^4(6x-x^2-8)\,dx\\&=18-\left[3x^2-\frac{x^3}{3}-8x\right]_2^4\\&=18-\left(-\frac{16}{3}+\frac{20}{3}\right)\\&=18-\frac43\\&=16\frac23\text{ u}^2.\end{aligned}$$
